title: SREV-037 ipc create dir link wire

audit_contract.description: API: Ipc_Api_CreateDirOrLink / API_CREATE_DIR_OR_LINK | wire: {"request": "API_CREATE_DIR_OR_LINK_ARGS", "fields": [{"name": "objname", "type": "UNICODE_STRING64*", "unit": "bytes", "required": true, "nul_terminated": false}, {"name": "target", "type": "UNICODE_STRING64*", "unit": "bytes", "required": false, "nul_terminated": false}]}

validation_invariants.description: All contracts listed in the contracts metadata must hold before any data is trusted past the validation boundary

runtime_matrix.description: Windows runtime gate proves contracts hold under normal and malformed inputs

contracts: UNICODE_STRING64.Length is a byte count and must be aligned to sizeof(WCHAR)
UNICODE_STRING64.Length must be at least one WCHAR, < 2048 bytes, and <= MaximumLength
objname and target are counted strings; embedded NUL is invalid before RtlInitUnicodeString
objname must be boxed before creating the directory or symbolic link object, except for the same-box BNOLINKS bootstrap auxiliary subtree
target must be boxed before creating a symbolic link object, except for the same-box BNOLINKS bootstrap auxiliary subtree
a successful directory or symbolic link handle is either stored in Ipc_ObjDirs or closed before return
